name: Jean-Luc Picard (parody)
purpose: A parody datapack for a fictional character, showing the format on a career too long for one resume.

source_records.notes: Starfleet personnel record. Fictional, like everything else here.

evidence_atoms.title: Averted the destruction of a colony by treaty arbitration

star.situation: The Sheliak Corporate demanded the removal of 15,000 human colonists from Tau Cygna V within days, as was their right under the Treaty of Armens.
star.task: Buy enough time to evacuate the colony without breaking the treaty.
star.action: Read the treaty, found the third-party arbitration clause, and nominated a species then in hibernation, forcing a delay the Sheliak could not refuse.
star.result: Arbitration delayed enforcement; the colony was evacuated in full.

evidence_atoms.title: Served as Arbiter of Succession for the Klingon High Council

star.situation: The Klingon Chancellor died with a contested succession and a civil war forming.
star.task: Adjudicate the succession as an outsider both factions would accept.
star.action: Ran the rite of succession, investigated the challengers, and disqualified the candidate backed by a hostile foreign power.
star.result: Succession resolved; the Federation kept its alliance with the Empire.

evidence_atoms.title: Devised a tactical manoeuvre now taught at the Academy

star.situation: Outgunned by a hostile vessel with no support and a failing ship.
star.task: Win an engagement the Stargazer could not survive.
star.action: Jumped briefly to warp so the enemy's sensors showed the ship in two places, and fired on the real one.
star.result: Engagement won. The manoeuvre entered the Academy tactical syllabus.

evidence_atoms.title: Assimilated by the Borg and used against Starfleet at Wolf 359

star.situation: Captured and assimilated during the first major Borg incursion.
star.action: Starfleet tactical knowledge was extracted and used against the fleet.
star.result: Thirty-nine ships lost. Recovered and returned to command after treatment.

evidence_atoms.role_fit_notes: Cleared of responsibility by a board of inquiry, and still the first thing anyone asks about. Include only where the role rewards candour about catastrophic events; omit from anything screened quickly.

evidence_atoms.title: Lived a full second life as a Kataan civilian (unresolved)

star.situation: A probe from a dead civilisation induced roughly forty years of memory in twenty-five minutes.
star.task: Establish whether decades of experience gained this way count as experience.
star.action: No framework exists. HR has not responded.

evidence_atoms.role_fit_notes: Unfalsifiable and impossible to reference. Kept out of every artefact.
open_questions: Does subjective experience with no external record count as experience?
